guarantees.claim: key_expand_prd_we is assigned 1 when key_full_we equals SP2V_HIGH, otherwise 0.

assumptions.claim: Whenever the data/mask inputs of the S‑Boxes update, key_full_we must be equal to SP2V_HIGH so that key_expand_prd_we is asserted and the internally buffered PRD is updated in sync.
assumptions.risk: If key_full_we does not match SP2V_HIGH, key_expand_prd_we stays 0, PRD is not updated, leading to mask desynchronization and potential leakage of side‑channel information.

uncertain_points.claim: The comparison key_full_we == SP2V_HIGH assumes a specific multi‑bit token; the width of key_full_we and the definition of SP2V_HIGH are not apparent from this chunk. It is unclear whether other legal values of key_full_we also require a PRD update.
uncertain_points.cond: When key_full_we takes a value different from SP2V_HIGH but a data/mask update occurs.
uncertain_points.risk: If a valid update condition is missed, the PRD will not be refreshed in time, potentially breaking the masking scheme.
